Patient guide

Fluoride treatment.

A quick, simple way to help protect your teeth.

Stronger enamel.

Fluoride is a natural mineral that strengthens enamel and helps protect your teeth from cavities.

Who it helps.

It's great for kids, and for adults with sensitive teeth, dry mouth, or a higher risk of cavities.

Quick and painless.

After your cleaning, a thin varnish is brushed onto your teeth. It only takes a minute.

It goes to work.

The varnish sets right away and keeps strengthening your enamel for hours afterward.

After your treatment.

Give the varnish time to soak in.

Soft foods for a few hoursSkip hot drinks todayWait to brush until tonight

Part of your routine.

Fluoride treatments are usually done at your regular checkups.

Questions? Just ask.

Your dental team is happy to walk you through every step before, during, and after your visit.
